description:
Follow-up to fz-94a (user: explain the unattributed part afterwards). Owner: Make Distiller Fast, dispatched by the user.

Scope (user, 2026-11-25): "attribute the raise and address it if necessary". Avoidable cost is removed here and the ceilings lowered to match. Lowering is free; any rise left over needs the user. An inherent cost goes to the user with its mechanism.

## Measured per commit

The five distiller figures (largest drive / total requests / drives / derivations / reads handed), fz2 built and run at each commit, exit 0 and expected stdout at every commit:

| commit | largest drive | total requests | drives | derivations | reads handed |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 66bfc7f89 (base) | 35201 | 35497 | 25 | 16384 | 118792 |
| aae3f942b #903 | 35613 | 35909 | 25 | 16603 | 121524 |
| 6c93ef9e0 #904 | 35817 | 36113 | 25 | 16744 | 122461 |
| 9b1ce17da #902 | 35817 | 36113 | 25 | 16744 | 122461 |
| a3dd6e8c7 #897 | 35816 | 36112 | 25 | 16743 | 122439 |
| 8b871e870 #899 | 35816 | 36112 | 25 | 16743 | 122439 |
| b1661a742 #900 | 35816 | 36112 | 25 | 16743 | 122439 |
| cd18bf4ab #901 | 35816 | 36112 | 25 | 16743 | 122439 |

- #903: +412 / +412 / +219 / +2,732, the user-accepted cost.
- #904 (fz-mue.7): +204 / +204 / +141 / +937. This is the whole remainder.
- #897: -1 / -1 / -1 / -22. Its ceilings are the base figures minus this saving; it was measured with neither #903 nor #904 beneath it.

## Mechanism (#904)

#904 moved the map builder and the put call into :maps and made Map delegate. Reconciled per function name over the two traces (rows sum to the rise):

| cause | requests | derivations | reads |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| new :maps.put/3 and :maps.fz_map_put/3 | +192 | +104 | +413 |
| new :maps.from_list/1, build/3, fz_map_from_kv/2, :lists.reverse/1,2 | +138 | +96 | +376 |
| removed Map.fz_map_put/3, Map.build/3, Map.fz_map_from_kv/2 | -113 | -73 | -248 |
| Map.put/3 (now forwards; +3 analyses) | +8 | +2 | +38 |
| module and code load (:lists is newly loaded, for reverse) | 0 | +16 | +43 |
| other functions, net (Enum.map_list/2 re-analysed 48 times, was 42) | -21 | -4 | +315 |

Map.put/3 has 11 activations and 6 executables; :maps.put/3 now has the same 11 and 6, paired one to one. A one-clause wrapper that only reorders its arguments costs a whole second activation, analysis and executable per specialization.

## Experiments at cd18bf4ab (library edits only, counts repeat exactly run to run)

| variant | largest drive | requests | derivations | reads |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| unmodified | 35816 | 36112 | 16743 | 122439 |
| A2: build calls :lists.reverse(x, []) | -22 | -22 | -17 | -67 |
| A: build uses a private reverse/2 in :maps | -24 | -24 | -30 | -108 |
| C: Map.put keeps its own guard and runtime call | -164 | -164 | -70 | -720 |
| A + C | -188 | -188 | -99 | -824 |
| #904's whole rise, for scale | +204 | +204 | +141 | +937 |

C undoes the Map -> :maps delegation for put, which the user chose to keep. What A + C leaves (+16 / +42 / +113) is the from_list layer and :maps' definitions.

Data: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-distill-hunt/4hl/ (table.txt, attr/, var/).

- 6c93ef9e0 #904: 35817/36113/25/16744/122461, i.e. +204/+204/0/+141/+937, the whole remainder
- 9b1ce17da #902: unchanged
- a3dd6e8c7 #897: 35816/36112/25/16743/122439, i.e. -1/-1/0/-1/-22
- #899, #900, #901: unchanged
#904's mechanism: Map.put/3 forwards to a new :maps.put/3, and the map builder moves into :maps. By job kind that adds 44 activation analyses, 16 executables and 4 function definitions. #904's PR did not mention the distiller rise, because it passed under the stale-high ceilings. Whether the forwarding layer's cost can be avoided is still open; a per-function reconciliation is running. Data: fz-distill-hunt/4hl/table.txt.

title: The distiller rise in the #897-#904 merge window is attributed per commit, and removed where it isn't needed
